lines.text: Many learners say: Please give me it.
Better: Please give it to me.
When it is a short word, say give it to me.
Give it to me! Please give it to me.

data.why: When it is a short word, say give it to me.

native.tip: it のような短い言葉は先に置いて、give it to me と言います。
native.caption: “Please give me it.”と言っていませんか？😅 「私に、それを」の順番で訳して give me it にしがちです。“Please give it to me.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“give it to me”。“Please give it to me.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Say give it to me, not give me it.
en.caption: Do you say this? “Please give me it.” 😅 Japanese puts me first, so people say give me it. The natural way is “Please give it to me.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
